datasets.name: joined_demand
queryLines:
SELECT
  g.transaction_date,
  g.transaction_month,
  g.product_name,
  g.product_category,
  g.destination_city,
  g.demand_quantity AS actual_demand,
  p.predicted_demand,
  p.model_name,
  p.model_version,
  p.mlflow_run_id,
  p.alias,
  (p.predicted_demand - g.demand_quantity) AS prediction_error,
  ABS(p.predicted_demand - g.demand_quantity) AS abs_error,
  g.avg_unit_price_usd,
  g.avg_available_inventory
FROM
  mle.gold.product_city_demand g
    INNER JOIN mle.models.demand_predictions p
      ON g.product_name = p.product_name
      AND g.destination_city = p.destination_city
      AND g.transaction_date = CAST(p.transaction_date AS DATE)

datasets.name: demand_by_category
queryLines:
SELECT
  g.product_category,
  SUM(g.demand_quantity) AS total_actual_demand,
  SUM(p.predicted_demand) AS total_predicted_demand,
  AVG(ABS(p.predicted_demand - g.demand_quantity)) AS avg_abs_error
FROM
  mle.gold.product_city_demand g
    INNER JOIN mle.models.demand_predictions p
      ON g.product_name = p.product_name
      AND g.destination_city = p.destination_city
      AND g.transaction_date = CAST(p.transaction_date AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  g.product_category
ORDER BY
  total_actual_demand DESC

datasets.name: model_evaluation
queryLines:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT
    g.demand_quantity AS actual_demand,
    p.predicted_demand,
    p.model_name,
    p.model_version,
    p.alias
  FROM
    mle.gold.product_city_demand g
      INNER JOIN mle.models.demand_predictions p
        ON g.product_name = p.product_name
        AND g.destination_city = p.destination_city
        AND g.transaction_date = CAST(p.transaction_date AS DATE)
),
model_means AS (
  SELECT
    model_name,
    model_version,
    alias,
    AVG(actual_demand) AS avg_actual_demand
  FROM
    joined
  GROUP BY
    model_name,
    model_version,
    alias
)
SELECT
  j.model_name,
  j.model_version,
  j.alias,
  COUNT(*) AS prediction_count,
  SUM(j.actual_demand) AS total_actual_demand,
  SUM(j.predicted_demand) AS total_predicted_demand,
  AVG(ABS(j.predicted_demand - j.actual_demand)) AS mae,
  SQRT(AVG(POWER(j.predicted_demand - j.actual_demand, 2))) AS rmse,
  1
    - SUM(POWER(j.predicted_demand - j.actual_demand, 2))
      / SUM(POWER(j.actual_demand - m.avg_actual_demand, 2)) AS r2,
  AVG(ABS((j.predicted_demand - j.actual_demand) / NULLIF(j.actual_demand, 0))) * 100 AS mape
FROM
  joined j
    INNER JOIN model_means m
      ON j.model_name = m.model_name
      AND j.model_version = m.model_version
      AND j.alias = m.alias
GROUP BY
  j.model_name,
  j.model_version,
  j.alias,
  m.avg_actual_demand

datasets.name: monthly_drift_metrics
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', g.transaction_date) AS drift_month,
  COUNT(*) AS prediction_count,
  AVG(ABS(p.predicted_demand - g.demand_quantity)) AS mae,
  SQRT(AVG(POWER(p.predicted_demand - g.demand_quantity, 2))) AS rmse,
  AVG(p.predicted_demand - g.demand_quantity) AS bias,
  AVG(ABS((p.predicted_demand - g.demand_quantity) / NULLIF(g.demand_quantity, 0))) * 100 AS mape,
  SUM(g.demand_quantity) AS total_actual,
  SUM(p.predicted_demand) AS total_predicted
FROM
  mle.gold.product_city_demand g
    INNER JOIN mle.models.demand_predictions p
      ON g.product_name = p.product_name
      AND g.destination_city = p.destination_city
      AND g.transaction_date = CAST(p.transaction_date AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', g.transaction_date)
ORDER BY
  drift_month

datasets.name: train_test_features
queryLines:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(transaction_date) AS min_date,
    DATEDIFF(MAX(transaction_date), MIN(transaction_date)) + 1 AS total_days
  FROM
    mle.gold.product_city_demand
),
split_pts AS (
  SELECT
    min_date,
    DATE_ADD(min_date, CAST(total_days * 0.64 AS INT)) AS train_end,
    DATE_ADD(min_date, CAST(total_days * 0.80 AS INT)) AS test_start
  FROM
    bounds
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        g.transaction_date
          <= (
            SELECT
              train_end
            FROM
              split_pts
          )
      THEN
        'Training'
      WHEN
        g.transaction_date
          >= (
            SELECT
              test_start
            FROM
              split_pts
          )
      THEN
        'Testing'
      ELSE 'Validation'
    END AS dataset_split,
    g.demand_quantity,
    g.avg_unit_price_usd,
    g.avg_available_inventory,
    g.avg_product_cost_usd,
    g.avg_supplier_reliability_score
  FROM
    mle.gold.product_city_demand g
),
stacked AS (
  SELECT
    'demand_quantity' AS feature_name,
    dataset_split,
    demand_quantity AS value
  FROM
    labeled
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'avg_unit_price_usd',
    dataset_split,
    avg_unit_price_usd
  FROM
    labeled
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'avg_available_inventory',
    dataset_split,
    avg_available_inventory
  FROM
    labeled
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'avg_product_cost_usd',
    dataset_split,
    avg_product_cost_usd
  FROM
    labeled
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'avg_supplier_reliability_score',
    dataset_split,
    avg_supplier_reliability_score
  FROM
    labeled
)
SELECT
  feature_name,
  dataset_split,
  COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
  AVG(value) AS mean_value,
  STDDEV(value) AS std_value,
  MIN(value) AS min_value,
  MAX(value) AS max_value,
  PERCENTILE(value, 0.25) AS p25,
  PERCENTILE(value, 0.5) AS median,
  PERCENTILE(value, 0.75) AS p75
FROM
  stacked
WHERE
  dataset_split IN ('Training', 'Testing')
GROUP BY
  feature_name,
  dataset_split
ORDER BY
  feature_name,
  dataset_split

datasets.name: train_test_monthly
queryLines:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(transaction_date) AS min_date,
    DATEDIFF(MAX(transaction_date), MIN(transaction_date)) + 1 AS total_days
  FROM
    mle.gold.product_city_demand
),
split_pts AS (
  SELECT
    min_date,
    DATE_ADD(min_date, CAST(total_days * 0.64 AS INT)) AS train_end,
    DATE_ADD(min_date, CAST(total_days * 0.80 AS INT)) AS test_start
  FROM
    bounds
)
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', g.transaction_date) AS month,
  CASE
    WHEN
      g.transaction_date
        <= (
          SELECT
            train_end
          FROM
            split_pts
        )
    THEN
      'Training'
    WHEN
      g.transaction_date
        >= (
          SELECT
            test_start
          FROM
            split_pts
        )
    THEN
      'Testing'
    ELSE 'Validation'
  END AS dataset_split,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count,
  AVG(g.demand_quantity) AS avg_demand,
  STDDEV(g.demand_quantity) AS std_demand,
  MIN(g.demand_quantity) AS min_demand,
  MAX(g.demand_quantity) AS max_demand,
  PERCENTILE(g.demand_quantity, 0.5) AS median_demand
FROM
  mle.gold.product_city_demand g
GROUP BY
  1,
  2
ORDER BY

datasets.name: drift_results
queryLines:
SELECT
  feature,
  ks_statistic,
  p_value,
  CASE
    WHEN p_value < 0.05 THEN 'Drift Detected'
    ELSE 'No Significant Drift'
  END AS drift_status,
  eval_date,
  comparison_type,
  train_rows,
  test_rows,
  reference_month,
  reference_year,
  current_month,
  current_year
FROM
  mle.monitoring.model_drift_ks_results
WHERE
  comparison_type = 'train_vs_test'
  AND eval_date
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(eval_date)
      FROM
        mle.monitoring.model_drift_ks_results
      WHERE
        comparison_type = 'train_vs_test'
    )
ORDER BY
  feature

datasets.name: drift_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_features,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN p_value < 0.05 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS drifted_features,
  CASE
    WHEN
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN p_value < 0.05 THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
      ) > 0
    THEN
      'Drift Detected'
    ELSE 'No Significant Drift Detected'
  END AS overall_status,
  MAX(eval_date) AS latest_eval_date,
  MAX(comparison_type) AS comparison_type,
  MAX(train_rows) AS train_rows,
  MAX(test_rows) AS test_rows
FROM
  mle.monitoring.model_drift_ks_results
WHERE
  comparison_type = 'train_vs_test'
  AND eval_date
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(eval_date)
      FROM
        mle.monitoring.model_drift_ks_results
      WHERE
        comparison_type = 'train_vs_test'

## Data Drift Monitoring

KS test results comparing **training vs testing** data distributions from `mle.gold.product_city_demand`. Results are read directly from `mle.monitoring.model_drift_ks_results` — no recalculation.

**Significance rule:** Raw p-values are used (adjusted p-values not available). A feature is flagged as **Drift Detected** when p-value < 0.05. Overall drift is detected if **any** feature exceeds this threshold.

description.value: Raw p-values from KS test comparing training vs testing distributions. Bars below the dashed line indicate statistically significant drift.
